flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob,helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper}, framework/schedulers/NotificationJobsScheduler, framework/controllers/NotificationSmsEmailController, utilities/smsutility/SmsUtil, utilities/emailutility/EmailService, application-*.properties and cron-schedules-*.properties; furnish_processing/FurnishApprovalHelper (source of the hirer contact). ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui, thirdpartyapi: not used
note: Status in stories.json: 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'; demo_remark: 'Vault Code Split. Vault needs to run as the notice needs to get vehicle and owner info' (Vault permission for the App Service: cannot verify from repo). There is no flow deck, so Sesuai means the code follows the story text. Epic OCMS9 is not in the repo as a document. The eNotification job (send_ena_reminder) picks notices at stage RD1 to DR3, refreshes mobile/email from DataHive, then validates the contact. The query does not distinguish roles: a hirer is included as the current offender and the contact comes from the furnish application. Two main findings: (1) the DataHive refresh is locked by cron.enareminder.datahive=false in dev, uat and prod, so the old contact is used; (2) cron.notification.enabled=false in all environments (prod: 'Disabled in PROD'), the job only runs through POST /notification-sms-email/execute. Also stage RD1 does not prove the letter reached the hirer (generation cron off, Toppan upload blocked, OCMS-DF-2026-192). Tickets used as hints: OCMS-DF-2026-180, OCMS-DF-2026-192. Same fits as OCMS12.3 (owner version). DOS = DataHive cannot be confirmed from repo.
recommendation: Claim partially. The selection and contact validation logic exists and applies to hirers, but the latest-contact refresh (DataHive) and the daily cron are switched off by config in all environments. Enable and prove cron.enareminder.datahive and cron.notification.enabled in PRD before a full claim.

steps.step: Hirer notices that have passed the 1st letter reminder (stage RD1) are selected for the electronic reminder
steps.detail: The eNotification job calls queryRecordsForReminder (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:162) and tags each row with the stage from last_processing_stage (174-180). The query selects last_processing_stage IN (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3), offender_indicator Y, not suspended (except TS-HST), ID not in the exclusion list, no notification record yet for the same stage, not an I/D/V vehicle, and due (last_processing_date + parameter POS + PDD) within the ENOTEDAYS window (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1076-1163). There is no hirer-role filter: a hirer is included because the furnish approval makes the hirer the current offender (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:555) and sets stage RD1 (648-652). Sebagian because 'the first letter was sent' is only inferred from the stage: letter generation by the 00:15 cron is switched off (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118 is commented out, letters only run through the manual trigger), the Toppan upload is blocked by sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan (application-prod.properties:86) yet the stage still advances through the delivery gate bypass (ToppanUploadJob.java:424-446, OCMS-DF-2026-192 Ready to UAT). So stage RD1 does not prove that the hirer received the letter.

steps.step: The latest mobile number / email of the hirer is fetched from DOS (DataHive) and saved to the hirer data on the notice
steps.detail: The job calls batchPreloadContactInfo and refreshContactInfo for all records (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:185-187). The live path exists: individuals are read from the Singpass view (CONTACT, at least 8 characters, NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2710-2745), companies from the CorpPass view (CP_ACCOUNT_EMAIL, only an ACTIVE A01 account, 2496-2560), and the result is patched into ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver (2800-2820). But refreshContactInfo and batchPreloadContactInfo return immediately unless cron.enareminder.datahive is 'true' (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2329, 2468) and the value is false in dev, uat and prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48). So the contact already stored in owner_driver is used; for a hirer who came in through furnish that is the contact from the furnish application (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:556-558). If DataHive is on and the contact is not found, a reminder-stage record only gets contactError and is skipped; the patch to RD1 is for ENA only. DOS = DataHive cannot be confirmed from repo. DataHive and Vault access from the App Service cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Contacts are validated: an individual needs a mobile number, a company needs an email; opted-out or passport hirers are not sent anything
steps.detail: validateContactInfo: a record with contactError, a company without email, or an individual without a phone number is rejected (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2259-2290); in the job, an invalid non-ENA record is skipped with no fallback (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:253-266). IDs in ocms_enotification_exclusion_list and ID type P/PASSPORT are skipped before the SMS is prepared (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:226-243). loadAllExcludedIds returns an empty set when the query fails (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1207-1215, fail-open), but the reminder query itself also drops IDs in the exclusion list in SQL (1131-1134), so opt-out for reminder stages is guarded twice. Maintaining the exclusion list is story OCMS9.3 and is not rated here.

steps.step: These checks run automatically in the daily batch before the electronic reminder is sent
steps.detail: NotificationJobsScheduler runs processMainFlow daily at 11:00, but only when cron.notification.enabled=true (NotificationJobsScheduler.java:42-55); the value is false in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236, comment 'Disabled in PROD to prevent sending SMS/Email notifications'). The job can still be triggered manually through POST /notification-sms-email/execute (NotificationSmsEmailController.java:38). Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-180 (Closed) is marked as waiting for the eNotification cron to be activated, and its fix only covers stage ENA; the reminder stages are unchanged. The real server property value cannot verify from repo.
